scientific_integrity: Uses the established birth–death fixation formula and standard Laplace asymptotics with explicit attribution. No independent review or experimental model validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Statement applies only to a separately specified well-mixed expected-payoff Fermi birth–death model and not the original finite hypergraph dynamics.
Selection intensity is fixed and positive, benefit lies in an open two-interior-root interval, and endpoint degeneracies are excluded.
Numerical samples supplement but do not replace an Euler–Maclaurin and lattice Laplace proof.
The result concerns fixation probabilities, not fixation times or the full quasistationary law.
title: A logarithmically shifted stochastic fixation threshold in a nonlinear mixed-order public-goods game
